fallback_suppression_method: Harness calls hypogeum.muapi._attempt_thumbnail_generation() directly with fallback_model='' (single-image path) and hypogeum.agents.thumbnail_compositor.generate_and_composite() (layered path, which has no fallback logic at all). generate_thumbnail()'s production provider chain (openrouter/openai/muapi) is never invoked by this harness. Production fallback order is unchanged.
seed_note: The gpt-image-2-text-to-image MUAPI payload (prompt, aspect_ratio, resolution, quality) exposes no seed parameter. Paired Condition A/C samples are NOT deterministically seeded — three independent samples per prompt are generated instead to reduce the influence of random generation variance.
retry_policy: Up to 3 attempts per sample, GPT Image 2 only, no cross-model fallback.
prompt_enhancement: None — MUAPI payload sends the prompt string verbatim.
